en-US.title: Studento
en-US.subtitle: Class countdown and bell clock
en-US.description:
Studento is a clock for school. It counts down to the end of every period, in seconds, so you always know how long is left.

SET IT UP IN A MINUTE
Take a photo of your schedule and Studento reads it on your phone, or type your classes. Great Neck North's bell times are built in, with Regular days and Wednesday Advisory, and you can enter your own school's times instead.

ALWAYS AT A GLANCE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show the time left in the period, then a live clock with seconds after school
• A Lock Screen countdown and Dynamic Island timer during class
• Bell alerts a few minutes into class and five minutes before the bell

MAKE IT YOURS
• More than 100 themes: split-flap boards, casino reels, gold Art Deco, LED signs, nixie tubes and more, each with its own typeface
• Three layouts, a focus timer, this week, notes, grades and homework
• Lock mode keeps the clock on screen with every setting out of reach until you hold the red dot

Studento runs entirely on your device. There are no accounts, no sign-in and no servers. Your schedule, settings and photos never leave your phone.
en-US.promoText: Count down every class. Runs entirely on your phone.

review.notes: Studento has no accounts or sign-in; nothing is needed to review it. On first launch choose "Skip for now" to use the built-in schedule, or "Type it out" and enter a line like "Period 1 Math 8:00-8:41". The app runs entirely on the device: the schedule scan uses on-device text recognition (Apple Vision), bell alerts are local notifications scheduled on the device, and no data is sent anywhere. Settings > Test > "Pretend it's Period 3" shows the countdown, widgets and Live Activity at any time of day. Widgets: long-press the Home Screen, add "Studento".
